subject: german

moments.title: Merkel becomes chancellor
moments.body: Merkel becomes Germany's first female chancellor; she will serve 16 years.

moments.title: Refugee policy
moments.body: Merkel keeps the German border open to Syrian refugees; 'Wir schaffen das' ('we can do this').
moments.takeaway: Single political moments reshape decades of demography.

moments.title: Zeitenwende
moments.body: Following Russia's invasion of Ukraine, Scholz announces a turning point in German foreign and defence policy.

now.title: Germany today
now.body: Energy transition, AfD rise and Ukraine support shape current politics. Germany is the EU's largest economy.
now.open_questions: What does German leadership of Europe look like next?

reflection: Germany's post-war stability has been continuously remade.
